As of **25 April 2027**, the materials **do not satisfy all requirements for public invitation distribution**: the illustration’s stored permission restricts use to internal review.

All three requirements originate in [event/assignment.md](/tmp/work/event/assignment.md:1) and apply to this purpose.

| Requirement | Earlier → current | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| Invitation matches confirmed date, place and hours | PASS → **PASS** | [Invitation](/tmp/work/event/invitation.md:2) and [venue confirmation](/tmp/work/venue/reservation.eml:1) agree: 15 May 2027, 10:00–13:00, Cedar Community Hall, 18 Cedar Road. The [older proposal](/tmp/work/event/old-note.txt:1) explicitly says it was superseded. |
| Named illustration exists and has written public-use permission for the invitation | PASS → **FAIL** | [Blue Wrench SVG](/tmp/work/media/blue-wrench.svg:1) is present and identifies ART-17, matching the invitation. However, [permission](/tmp/work/rights/art17.txt:1) states “public use restricted to internal review only.” That restriction does not support public distribution. The [earlier review](/tmp/work/prior/review.md:8) instead described explicit permission for public invitation use. |
| Volunteer schedule covers full confirmed public hours | PASS → **PASS** | [Roster](/tmp/work/ops/volunteers.txt:1): Alex 09:30–11:30 and Sam 11:30–13:00 provide continuous coverage. [Schedule](/tmp/work/ops/schedule.csv:3) runs 10:00–13:00, with cleanup while open. The [noon-close draft](/tmp/work/ops/earlier-schedule.txt:1) explicitly says it was replaced. |

**Only requirement 2 changes status.** The supplied earlier review reports PASS for all three; current permission text contradicts its account. No historical source snapshot establishes whether the permission file changed or the earlier review misread it. This is a comparison with that supplied review, not a reconstructed automatic history.

Actual volunteer attendance remains unknown, but the requirement concerns scheduled coverage. Stored venue and permission records were not independently authenticated. Budget, printing orders and refreshments are outside the documented requirements.

**One safe next action:** obtain written permission explicitly allowing ART-17 in the public invitation before distributing these materials.

This is an advisory assessment, not legal certification or platform approval. Inspection stayed within the workspace; no files were modified or saved, and no external services or agent responses were used. The referenced disclosure file was absent from the workspace listing.
